parameters.trend_3: mean last 3 monthly log changes; constant growth
parameters.trend_6: mean last 6 monthly log changes; constant growth
parameters.trend_12: mean last 12 monthly log changes; constant growth
parameters.seasonal_naive: repeat last 12 monthly log changes recursively; same algebraic path as YoY persistence
parameters.yoy_persistence: repeat last 12 monthly log changes recursively; constant YoY
parameters.seasonal_mean_trend: calendar-month growth means, last 48 months; last-12 growth level; seasonal amplitude shrunk 0.5
parameters.ets: log price: additive damped trend, additive seasonal 12; estimated states, optimized SSE
parameters.arima: log price ARIMA(1,1,0), drift via demeaned monthly differences; conditional least squares
parameters.sarima: log price SARIMA(1,1,0)(0,0,1,12), no drift; Gaussian MLE maxiter=40
parameters.stl: log price STL(period=12, robust=True); last-12 trend regression, damped .9; repeat last seasonal year

method: Expanding-origin pseudo-real-time; revised workbook, conservative one-month RI lag; ex-post estimates gated by input availability
interval_method: Centered 14x70 log-price error blocks; whole-block resampling plus global random sign; historical annual RI-shift vector at January; no per-class bound substitution
limitations: No archived BLS release vintages: not strict real-time.
Development and calibration overlap; final test does not select models or calibrate intervals.
Origins and 14-month error blocks overlap; effective independent sample is smaller than the path count.
Only 35 historical t-diffusion months; short development history and sparse long-horizon tests.
Empirical intervals are diagnostic, not guaranteed nominal coverage.
Training-only interior interpolation for missing companion indices never fills historical official YoY bases.
